caption: The drawing features two distinct black metal objects placed against a plain, light beige background. The object at the top is a screw-like fastener with a thick, flat, T-shaped head and a ridged shank extending horizontally to the right. The bottom object is an elongated, flat, and straight piece of metal hardware that widens into a circular shape on the left, with three holes visible within the round section, and extends into a narrow, straight bar with another hole near the right end, finishing in a smaller, rounded tip. The leftmost part of this object has a cylindrical loop offset on the side, likely for hinge attachment. Both objects are illustrated with a dark, textured surface, and the signature "Grant Vanderpool" appears on the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Hardware (Hinge)
